title: Prioritize enterprise adoption pathways and model gating for catalog requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit model-related requests (new model add, version pin, early deprecation warnings) that require faster, predictable triage and standardized gating. Current ad-hoc handling causes delays, inconsistent criteria, missed SLAs for Dedicated/Private customers, and duplicate work for evaluations and security review.

Goal: Define a prioritized adoption pathway and triage rubric tailored to enterprise needs that standardizes intake, scoring, and gating for the model catalog. This ticket captures the product-side proposal, acceptance criteria, stakeholders, and implementation tasks for the first-phase rollout (triage matrix + mandatory eval gate for high-impact requests).
acceptance_criteria: A documented triage rubric that scores requests across stability risk, customer SLA, regulatory footprint, and expected volume
A routing matrix that sends: P0/P1 enterprise requests to expedited eval queue and security review; P2 to standard pipeline; deprecations flagged to support+customers ops
An operational SLA: enterprise model add/major-version-pin decisions within 10 business days (unless security/infra blockers exist)
Eval gate defined with inputs (prompt set, target metrics, regression thresholds) and a standardized evaluation checklist
Playbook for temporary pinning and rollback: documented steps, owner, and automation hooks for rollback requests
proposed_triage_flow: 1) Intake form enrichment: add fields for enterprise tier, compliance requirements, expected QPS, model family, and sample prompts. 2) Auto-score: run a deterministic score (customer_tier, data_sensitivity, expected_latency_impact, model_novelty). 3) Route: score >= 8 -> expedited enterprise queue (PM+Applied ML+Security); 4-7 -> standard review; <=3 -> backlog. 4) If expedited: trigger eval gate and security checklist in parallel; 5) Post-approval: schedule rollout (canary -> 50% -> full) with observability hooks.
scoring_matrix: Scoring axes: customer_tier (1-3), data_sensitivity (0-3), regression_risk (0-3), infra_cost_impact (0-2), compliance_scope (0-3). Example: enterprise premium (3) + PHI present (3) + regression high (3) + high infra cost (2) + SOC2 requirements (3) => total 14 -> Escalate.
tasks: Draft intake form fields and update the support portal - PM
Work with Applied ML to define minimal eval artifact (prompt set, metrics) - PM + AM-Lab
Coordinate with Security to create a checklist for KMS/compliance and required artifacts - PM + Security
Implement an automated scoring prototype in the intake form (low-fi rules) - Eng
Document rollback/playbook and runbook for pinning decisions - PM + Support
Pilot with two enterprise accounts for 30-day cycle and collect telemetry
open_questions: What threshold triggers a mandatory formal security review vs. a lightweight checklist?
How do we price expedited evals for enterprise customers (cost-recovery or included)?
Should pinned-version requests for Hosted customers follow the same SLA as Dedicated/Private?
What is the canonical owner for deprecation communications to customers and what lead time is acceptable for enterprise contracts?
stakeholder_notes: Sales: wants a guaranteed decision window for premium customers; proposes 5 business days but accepts 10 if automation reduces false positives
Applied ML: requests clearer artifact requirements (sample prompts + reference golden outputs) to reduce eval churn
Security: flags KMS/HSM and data residency as gating items for any model handling customer PII/PHI
Support: needs templated messages for deprecation and pin-successful rollout notifications
